ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Люди науки» (lyudi nauki, 'people of science') is kept literally, as is «седалище Моисеево» ('the seat of Moses', cf. Matthew 23:2). «Патеры» (patery) are 'Catholic priests', the meaning of the Russian word; «рассудок» (rassudok) is 'mind'.
